samples.question: The image is divided by thin lines into four quadrants: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, and bottom-right. Each quadrant contains one dark outline contour. Exactly one of the four contours is completely closed: a full ring whose two ends meet with no gap. The other three contours are open arcs that each have a visible gap in the ring. Which quadrant contains the only completely closed contour? Answer with the quadrant name.
